note: Set A is better because it avoids inventing specific conditions that are factually incorrect, such as Set B's claim that the HSS member is in 'DETAIL A1' (it is in A3) or that the beam is on the 'upper level'. Both sets share significant errors: misbinding the 3/4" holes to the deck opening plate instead of the PV attachment base, and misreading the '1\'-0" MIN' dimension as a maximum. Set A's vaguer entity names are preferable to Set B's specific but wrong conditions.
remarks: Both sets incorrectly extract the quote for the bolt connection (inserting '3"' into the text) and misattribute the 3/4" holes from the PV Attachment detail (A1) to the Deck Opening plate (A5/B5). Both also misread '1\'-0" MIN' as a maximum opening dimension.
